title: Grateful Dead Live at Tivolis Koncertsal on 1972-04-14
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Profesional v8.01 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> (16 Track) Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1972 Europe ’72 show with smoking Dark Star, pedal‑steel Looks Like Rain and standout Jerry Garcia solos.
ai_review.review: Fans rave that this Miller‑fixed soundboard recording is crystal‑clear and perfectly balanced, letting the band’s tight groove and soaring improvisations shine. The concert delivers nonstop excitement—from a punchy first set into a second set highlighted by Dark Star > Sugar Mag, Looks Like Rain on pedal steel, and fiery Pig Pen moments—making it one of the most celebrated Europe ’72 dates.

ai_rating.rationale: All seven reviews are overwhelmingly positive (5‑star), praising both performance and sound quality; the recording is a Miller‑fixed soundboard, and the show is described as high‑energy with multiple standout songs.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller‑fixed SBD source noted as "better" and "crisp"; listeners comment on clear mix, good instrument separation and no major dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A tight, bouncy first set flows seamlessly into an inspired second set, maintaining high excitement from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for phenomenal solos, especially his pedal‑steel on Looks Like Rain and jazzy fills throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for solid bass work (e.g., on Casey Jones) that helped lock in the groove.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s playing highlighted as a standout—great on Chinatown, El Paso and Beat It On Down the Line.
